The checker prints **ALL PASS**: all 27 of 27 transitions replay exactly.

The rule in `program.py`:

| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| 4 | The cursor moves to the next word slot. At the end of a row, it goes to the first slot of the next row. From the last row, it goes back to row 0. |
| 3 | The cursor moves to the previous word slot. |
| 1, 2 | No change. |

- **Word slots:** In each legend row, legends that are 2 cells apart or closer make one word. The cursor stops only at the start of a word. This is why it goes from x=20 to x=39 and does not stop at x=27.
- **Cursor height:** The cursor's y is always 4 less than the y of its row.

Two parts of the rule are guesses, because no transition shows them. The header comment states both:
- Action 3 at the start of a row goes back to the end of the previous row. I made this the same as the action 4 wrap, but it never occurs in the data.
- Actions 1 and 2 never change anything here. The legends are tagged "editable", so these actions probably edit a legend in some other condition.
